newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Kaucuk CZK 465.5 mln 96 gross profit.
newsitem.headline: Czech Kaucuk CZK 465.5 mln 96 gross profit.

text.p: Czech petrochemical firm Kaucuk Group a.s. on Friday said its pre-audited 1996 gross profit should hit 465.46 million crowns.

Kaucuk posted a 1.44 billion crown gross profit for 1995, but company officials said the result is not comparable since its refining operations were hived off last year -- along with those of Chemopetrol a.s. -- to form Ceska Rafinerska a.s..
Without the refining operations, Kaucuk Group's 1995 gross profit was about 964 million crowns.
Kaucuk did not give any further results.

In a deal completed last year, the consortium IOC, which consists of three foreign oil groups bought a 49 percent stake in Ceska Rafinerska, a company set up to operate the two main refineries at Litvinov and Kralupy, which earlier belonged to Chemopetrol and Kaucuk repsectively.
The IOC is equally owned by DuPont Co unit Conoco, Royal Dutch Shell, and Italy's Agip. The state holds the remaining 51 percent stake in Rafinerska through the holding company Unipetrol a.s..
The remaining parts of Kaucuk and Chemopetrol, both controlled by the state, are to complete a merger into Unipetrol with a share swap planned for later this year.
